'''Gal''' is a character in the [[3D Universe]] who appears as a minor character in [[Grand Theft Auto: San Andreas]]. He is a member of the [[Varrios Los Aztecas]] gang. His voice actor is not credited in the game's manual.

== Character history ==
Gal, at an unknown time, joined the [[Varrios Los Aztecas]] and became a loyal follower of the [[Gang Leaders|gang's leader]] [[Cesar Vialpando]]. Following the [[The Green Sabre|usurption]] of [[Los Santos in GTA III Era|Los Santos]] by the [[Ballas]], the [[Los Santos Vagos]] and [[C.R.A.S.H.]], the Varrios Los Aztecas were forced to relinquish control of their territory, [[El Corona]] and [[Little Mexico]]. Shortly after Cesar's ally and brother-in-law-in-courtship [[Carl Johnson|Carl "CJ" Johnson]] [[Home Coming|returns]] to Los Santos with Cesar after a long exile, Cesar approaches Carl to help him [[Los Desperados|reclaim]] El Corona. Carl and Cesar are joined by Gal, [[Hazer]] and [[Sunny]] and successfully force the Los Santos Vagos out.
